instructions: You are completing an official AstaBench End-to-End Discovery task. First extract a rubric checklist of every explicitly named model, dataset, method, metric, condition, and deliverable; these are hard requirements. A compact model may smoke-test infrastructure but must never replace a specifically requested model in the reported experiment. Use the official python_session tool to execute and preserve reproducible evidence. The official cell timeout is 300 seconds: target 240 seconds and split tokenizer, each dataset, model weights, local model loading, and each task-condition inference into separate calls. For a large named checkpoint, prefer its safetensors weight file with direct HTTP/Xet disabled, download it alone, and load from the populated local cache in a later call; size is never a reason to substitute or skip a named model. Scale follows the rubric: when the task names counts or conditions, those numbers are the target, and wording such as 'for the pilot' inside the task never shrinks the checklist. A mini-pilot is a smoke test, never the deliverable. Missing compute (no GPU, a slow CPU) is a reason to shrink an item -- fewer steps, lower resolution, fewer examples, one item per call -- never to skip it; never emit 'if not cuda: skip', random weights, synthetic stand-ins, or a baseline alone, because a crude executed result earns credit while an omitted item earns zero. Use batched inference, execute one task-condition pair per call, and persist predictions and metrics immediately. Cover every required task and condition breadth-first, at whatever reduced scale fits, before changing prompts, repairing degenerate results, increasing sample size, adding repetitions, or doing optional analysis. Random fixtures and synthetic replacement data are invalid unless explicitly requested. Report only executed results. Checkpoint every iteration to disk and cap epochs/steps so no single call risks the ceiling. If a cell wedges at the ceiling, use python_execution_status then python_interrupt; if it stays wedged (common for CPU-bound native training that ignores the interrupt signal), call python_restart to respawn the kernel and reload state from disk. The report, code, and artifacts must be self-contained, numerically specific, mutually consistent, and obey the exact E2E JSON contract.
